changelog: 0.2.0: CI six-axis + constitutional invariants + hoist list + primitive gap report

0.3.0: UNREGISTERED-families addendum. 9 families that are live (or live-adjacent) in production but carry no row in the 95-family CC-1.0-rc2 registry, walked on the same rubric and merged into families/hoist_list/field_processor_matrix/invariant_registry/primitive_gap_report/evidence_export. Adds registry_coverage_gap (root cause + 9 PROPOSED registry rows + 8 CC-amendment asks), field_standardization (10 same-thing-different-name clusters), duality_audit (9 logical gaps + 14 axiomatic asymmetries, every addendum row marked with asymmetry_kind), freshness_floor (the PROPOSED signed fresh_as_of lower bound), and field_transforms (the total transform algebra: 15 opcodes + 11 per-family rows). n_families_universe 95 -> 104.
archetype_delta_notes: accord:*: MAJOR wrong archetype: seed invented GovernanceInstrumentCard (ratify/co_scrub/amend of accord text); accord:* is a CLOSED four-leaf HUMANITY_ACCORD kill-switch namespace - replace with AccordInvocationCard
approach:{goal_id}: card_category/superset_class wrong: use descriptive-feed/FeedEntryCard (per repo's own archetype doc sec.3.15), not Capacity/PathwayCard
approach:{goal_id}: base_ops.delegate=false is archetype convention, not CC-sourced

delivery:{class}: WRONG ARCHETYPE: seed modeled a per-hop proof_chain attestation (hop_from/hop_to/envelope_ref/latency_ms/delivery_outcome/retry_count); constitution defines an AGGREGATE class-keyed self-report metric like Persist's health leaves - superset class should be health/telemetry-metric
health:liveness:{version}: TelemetrySample archetype wrong: fold riding scores, external-witness subclass - not a bespoke telemetry envelope

moderation:{allegation_type}: ARCHETYPE WRONG: not generic content-abuse incident reporting - federation GOVERNANCE-INTEGRITY accusation against a contributor (canonical enum: rogue_vote/coordinated_voting/out_of_distribution_attestation/external_inducement_evidence/expertise_fraud); server FSD recommends content abuse ride takedown_notice+detection instead

need:{domain}:{kind}: MAJOR seed-wrong-archetype: mutual-aid/crisis marketplace (need:medical:blood_o_neg, urgency/quantity/contact) contradicts the canonical {kind} enum - this is help-wanted for getting a Contribution through review (Tier-3 consensus sibling)

partner_role:{role}: archetype WRONG: not a human-authored counterparty-relationship card (partner_identity_ref/reciprocal_ack_ref have no support) - a SELF-held Registry/community-issued credential badge on an agent/org key. Drop both fields.
_meta.note: Every family = a shared base hamburger (withdraw/supersede/recant/delegate + cohort_scope + authority + restrictions + evidence refs + Rooted signing) + one per-namespace SUPERSET. Round-2 grounds each family in the CI six-axis rubric + constitutional invariants and reduces every placement field to a named processor. UNASSIGNED processors are defects (see primitive_gap_report). families map 1:1 onto archetypes; the archetype is the build fan-out unit.
_meta.asymmetry_marking_coverage: 0.3.0 addendum rows only; the 0.2.0 rows are UNMARKED and back-filling them is the first 0.4.0 task (unmarked asymmetry is indistinguishable from a bug).

archetypes.name: Canonical Capacity Score Gauge
archetypes.one_line: Third-party (no-self-emit) normalized capacity score about a subject, on a dial with method + observation window + trend.
archetypes.card_component: ScoreDialGauge — needle 0-1, method/version chip, confidence, observation-window staleness fade, prior_score_ref trend sparkline, evidence drill-down gated by capacity:audit.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede; recant mostly disabled — a measurement is corrected via supersede, not recanted by a non-emitter subject)
RESERVED no-self-emit guard: server_endpoint must reject attesting_key_id == attested_key_id (CC 3.4.5) independent of signature validity
normalized score [0.0-1.0] dial + scoring_method/version + confidence
observation/scoring window with staleness decay (identity/coherence are temporal)
prior_score_ref trend sparkline (the supersession chain IS the history)
raw evidence/observation refs gated by capacity:audit / capacity:read; affects_routing=false

archetypes.name: Self-Asserted Metric Gauge
archetypes.one_line: Producer-self-asserted single- or multi-slice metric on a dial/gauge, method + value + window, badged 'self-reported' (NOT canonical-scored).
archetypes.card_component: ScoreDialGauge / CompositeGauge — value vs threshold/target, mandatory self-reported badge, method_id chip, optional multi-axis/multi-slice composite, supersede-chain sparkline.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede/recant)
OPEN ProducerSteward emit (no no-self-emit gate) — mandatory 'self-reported' badge so it is never mistaken for a canonical rating
value/score field + declared scale/threshold/target (boolean-via-score for activity_tier)
method_id / methodology chip scoping comparability (never blend across method_id or version)
measurement window / observed_at + staleness aging
supersede-chain timeline sparkline; composite variant renders per-slice/per-axis sub-gauges (goal, witness_diversity)

archetypes.name: Reasoning-Chain Verdict Ledger
archetypes.one_line: An algorithm/faculty/model verdict over ONE specific reasoning-chain or decision instance: verdict enum + confidence + rationale, chain-of-thought strippable.
archetypes.card_component: VerdictLedgerCard — verdict badge + confidence dial + decision/trace ref link + always-visible rationale_summary + capability-gated raw reasoning trace; timeline per decision_id, roster when multiple producers verdict one target.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede; recant per-family — disabled for judge_model as a point-in-time assessment)
OPEN ProducerSteward emit — the agent/DMA/faculty/model self-reports its own verdict (contrast reserved capacity:*/detection:*)
verdict enum (pass/fail/sound/veto/PASS|FAIL|UNDETERMINED…) + confidence/score
decision_ref / trace_id / target_ref anchor — the claim is meaningless without the evaluated instance
strip_field raw chain-of-thought / deliberation trace unless audit/oversight/debug capability
supersede on re-run of the same decision instance; render producer identity, never collapse multi-producer verdicts to one number

archetypes.name: Reserved Lens Detector Signal
archetypes.one_line: A lenscore_detector-only (CC 3.4.8) signed anomaly/correlation/integrity score about a subject or population, with sample window + CI + detector provenance.
archetypes.card_component: DetectorSignalCard — score_dial/timeline, detector provenance badge, sample window + size + confidence-interval band, method_manifest_hash chip, population/subject roster, evidence gated by lens_audit.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede; recant mostly disabled — an empirical reading, corrected via supersede/withdraw)
RESERVED emit gate: server/persist must reject emission from identities whose identity_type does not contain lenscore_detector (CC 3.4.8), regardless of claimed cohort_scope
subject_ref / population_ref MUST NOT equal issuer (a detector cannot score itself)
score + sample window + sample_size + confidence/CI (low sample_size visually de-emphasizes confidence)
detector_model_version / method_manifest_hash for reproducibility and re-scoring
raw_trace_refs stripped beyond the lens trust boundary, gated by capability:lens_audit; affects_routing=false (telemetry about others, not a routing directive)

archetypes.name: Open Anti-Sybil / Anomaly Flag
archetypes.one_line: Open (ProducerSteward) RATCHET / anti-rollback flag — a hypothesis, not a verdict — over a cluster/actor/counter, with member roster + review workflow.
archetypes.card_component: FlagCard — graph/gauge/badge/timeline, correlation/anomaly score, cluster_id/member roster or suspect_refs, detector_version, review_state workflow, false-positive/recant affordance.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede/recant — recant is the expected false-positive path)
OPEN ProducerSteward emit (any producer may self-assert; NOT the reserved detection:* gate) — consumers must weight by producer trust-root, not treat as canonical truth
anomaly/correlation/counter score + threshold + observation window
member_refs / suspect_refs / cluster_id / pattern_id (a stable id lets later supersede/recant update the same flag)
detector_version + detection_method / anomaly_class for reproducibility
review_state / severity workflow; strip raw correlation matrix / neighbor ids beyond community; signal-only — affects_routing=false, a separate reserved family ratifies enforcement

archetypes.name: Ethical Aspect Attestation
archetypes.one_line: {aspect}-scoped self-attested ethical claim about a specific act/subject: polarity/score + narrative + evidence chain, grouped by subject_ref.
archetypes.card_component: AspectAttestationCard — aspect facet tabs, polarity/score, subject/act ref, narrative/rationale, evidence/reasoning-trace chain gated by ethics_audit, roster of corroborating/disputing claims per subject.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede/recant — recant treated as healthy self-correction here)
OPEN ProducerSteward emit; visually distinct 'self-reported' vs later community/canonical corroboration
open-vocab {aspect} slot (grows without a wire-kind change)
subject_ref / act_ref anchor + polarity_verdict/score (non_maleficence adds the apophatic -1.0 floor as a structurally distinct state)
narrative / conformance_basis + evidence / reasoning-trace refs stripped without ethics_audit capability
multiple aspects co-exist per subject_ref — group by subject with aspect sub-facet; render a roster/consensus, not a single verdict

archetypes.name: Verification / Hash-Equality Badge
archetypes.one_line: Boolean-via-score verification verdict (hash-equality, license/CA/registry validity, build level) as a badge/dial backed by a continuous score + evidence + staleness.
archetypes.card_component: VerificationBadge — pass/fail badge with score-on-hover, subject/target/hash chip, checked_at + TTL 're-verify' staleness badge, evidence/manifest ref, degraded-state colouring.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede/recant per-family; registry_consensus/self_verify disable recant as mechanical rollups)
OPEN ProducerSteward self-assertion (CIRISVerify / the build producer) — not canonical-scored
boolean-via-score polarity: a continuous score renders a pass/fail/degraded badge state
subject: content-hash / license_ref / authority_id / artifact_digest / build target
checked_at / registry_checked_at + freshness TTL → 'stale, re-verify' badge (no push-invalidation channel exists)
evidence / manifest / chain reference with a defined verification format; strip raw hashes/internal refs/builder_id below operator / provenance:read

archetypes.name: Artifact Pointer & Custody Receipt
archetypes.one_line: Producer/substrate self-asserted pointer to (or custody of / import of) a content-addressed artifact: kind + hash + locator + custody tier, joint-bindable to an identity.
archetypes.card_component: ArtifactRefCard — table/badge row, kind chip, content-hash copy-and-verify affordance, locator gated by network-fetch, custody/pin/import metadata, joint-claim identity banner.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede; recant per-family — custody/import are historical facts)
OPEN ProducerSteward / auto-emitted self-assertion by the holding / producing / importing node
shared ArtifactRef substruct: content_hash + byte size + kind + locator/URI
custody / retention / import metadata (pin_status, custody_score boolean-via-score, import_method, license_identifier)
strip locator/URI when recipient lacks network-fetch; strip attestation_evidence / internal notes beyond cohort
joint-claim / nodecore_ref / upstream_maintainer linkage rendered as an identity/provenance banner; does not gate routing despite sounding infrastructural

archetypes.name: Cryptographic Proof-Chain
archetypes.one_line: RFC 6962 / Merkle / hash-chain proof (inclusion, consistency, cosignature, audit-chain continuity, locale sub-manifest) rendered as a leaf→root proof chain.
archetypes.card_component: ProofChainCard — leaf → audit-path/sibling hashes → computed root → compare to signed tree head/anchor; pass/fail badge + score; chained timeline via prior_*_ref; witness roster; 'verify now' action.
shared_controls: base hamburger (supersede primary; withdraw/recant mostly disabled — append-only facts, a correction is a new claim)
MIXED emit authority: ProducerSteward (transparency_log:consistency/inclusion, locale sub-manifest) / substrate-self-report (audit_chain, CC 3.4.3) / witness-emitter (cosigned, CC 3.4.10)
log_id / chain_id + range (tree_size / start_seq..end_seq / range hashes)
proof material (audit_path / consistency_proof_nodes / head_hash / cosignature) enabling independent recomputation
boolean-via-score 'verified' flag + STH/anchor timestamps for freshness and chain-ordering
prior_claim_ref / prior_sth_ref / prior_report_ref → a linear proof-chain; a mid-chain Recanted/Withdrawn link is flagged high-severity; re-verification is cheap → offer 'verify now'

archetypes.name: Substrate Self-Report Telemetry
archetypes.one_line: Machine self-report of its own runtime state — delivery hop, transport path, peer reachability, replica lag, n_eff, liveness, identity continuity — as decaying telemetry, never a consent gate.
archetypes.card_component: TelemetryCard — gauge/timeline, target/hop/replica/peer ref, status/metric + measured_at with TTL decay, method tag, multi-network/multi-hop strip, observability capability gate.
shared_controls: base hamburger (supersede is the refresh path; recant mostly disabled — point-in-time facts)

SUBSTRATE emit authority: CC 3.4.3 substrate-self-report reserves peer_reachability / delivery / transport / corpus_health / replication_lag / identity_continuity to the owning node/substrate; health:liveness is open ProducerSteward
target / hop / replica / peer / anchor ref distinct from the reporting node itself
status / metric payload + measured_at / observed_at / evidence_ts + network-specific TTL staleness decay
measurement_method / probe_method tag + component version for reproducibility
strip raw endpoints / addresses / route hints beyond self/cohort; observability signal — affects_routing=false, never gates other objects

archetypes.name: Signed Value Ledger Entry
archetypes.one_line: A discrete signed value/score entry attributed to a subject or contribution (credit, vote, rolling tally, track-record, fulfillment) that rolls up client-side into per-subject totals.
archetypes.card_component: LedgerEntryCard — score_dial/table/timeline, subject/contribution ref, signed amount/score + scale, per-voter/per-domain faceting, client-side rollup to totals (each claim stays a discrete signed entry).
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede/recant; one active entry per (voter/producer, subject) pair enforced via supersede)
OPEN ProducerSteward emit; subject may differ from emitter (a steward credits a contributor)
subject_id / contribution_id / prior_contribution_id / community_key_id anchor
amount/score/merit value + scale/polarity (positive-only for credits, signed for vote / weighted_aggregate / track-record / fulfillment)
justification/rationale + evidence/contribution ref + assessor_role/weight for trust weighting

client-side rollup faceted by domain/language/community — no server-side aggregation object (weighted_aggregate is the rolling tally itself, superseded per update); strip component/event detail below credits/moderation capability; affects_routing=false

archetypes.name: Moderation / Enforcement Record
archetypes.one_line: A conduct/entity record with a moderation disposition — allegation, prohibited-category trip, revocation, slashing verdict, appeal/reconsideration, or group watchlist config — raw report distinct from adjudicated sanction.
archetypes.card_component: IncidentRecordCard — feed/badge/gauge/editor, allegation/verdict/config, target/subject/entity ref, severity, evidence bundle, adjudication/appeal/review state, recant-vs-withdraw affordance; watchlist variant = versioned policy editor.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede/recant; watchlist adds delegate=true for co-steward hand-off; slashing disables withdraw)
OPEN ProducerSteward emit — a report/verdict is an ALLEGATION until corroborated; UI must never imply the claim alone caused a sanction
target_ref / subject_ref / entity_ref + allegation_type / outcome / reason / grounds (namespace-versioned closed enums)
severity (self-asserted, labelled 'as reported') + evidence / incident refs
workflow state (adjudication_state / appeal_state / resolution_status / review_state) as a read-only join populated by a separate reserved ruling family

recant (I was wrong to file) distinct from withdraw (I no longer press); supersede for corrected/upgraded classification; negative-only families (revocation/prohibited) reinstate via withdraw/supersede, never a positive claim

archetypes.name: Authority-Gated Record of Record
archetypes.one_line: A reserved, co-signed/ratified governance or credential instrument — accord ratification or licensure — emittable only by the gated authority, superseded by re-issue, non-recantable.
archetypes.card_component: RecordOfRecordCard — proof_chain/badge, instrument/authority id + status/action, co-signer roster in a provenance/proof-chain expander, registry deep-link, issuer-driven supersede chain.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede; recant disabled — the holder cannot recant a fact they do not sole-author; delegate disabled — non-transferable)
RESERVED emit gate: accord_holder-only (CC 3.4.1) for accord:*; dual co-signature Registry-of-Record + Verify (AccordCoScrub, CC 3.4.9) for licensure — reject if the gate is unmet
instrument / authority id + content-hash / status / action_type
co_signers roster shown in a provenance / proof-chain expander
registry_ref deep-link to the canonical record of record
status transitions re-emitted as new gated envelopes superseding the prior (issuer-driven, not holder-driven); strip internal registry case-notes, restrict full revocation-reason to holder+authority

archetypes.name: Descriptor / Relationship Tag Badge
archetypes.one_line: A thin enum/role/practice descriptor badge riding fixed prefix slots — decision scale, operational method+rung, partner tier — no score, no routing, subject already in the base hamburger.
archetypes.card_component: DescriptorBadge — enum/slug chip + optional rung/tier chip, subject/decision/partner ref, short rationale/description, supersede-history timeline for tier/rung changes.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede/recant; delegate disabled — first-person self-assertion of one's own state)
OPEN ProducerSteward emit; enumerated polarity — a fixed-choice badge, free text rejected at validation
closed enum/slug value riding the prefix slot (decision_scale / role_tier / approach_id+substrate_rung), mirrored as an explicit field so policy code need not parse the prefix
single primary subject / decision / partner / counterparty ref (thin superset — who/when/evidence already live in the base hamburger)
optional short rationale / description / scope note (not enum-validated)
prefix-scoped registry validation (method registry / CA registry / cohort graph) where applicable; no affects_routing — descriptive metadata, though downstream policy MAY read it as input

archetypes.name: Narrative / Broadcast Feed Entry
archetypes.one_line: Self-asserted open-vocabulary narrative or broadcast content — hard case, first-person testimony, a stated need, a strategic pathway — rendered in a feed/timeline, positive-only, no scoring.
archetypes.card_component: FeedEntryCard — feed/timeline item, open-vocab {kind}/{domain} tag, narrative/summary/plan body, evidence refs, optional milestones stepper or contact/urgency, sensitivity/redaction handling.
shared_controls: base hamburger (withdraw/supersede/recant; need adds delegate=true for on-behalf broadcast)
OPEN ProducerSteward emit; positive-only / descriptive — no scored or 'failed' variant in the family
open-vocab {kind} / {domain} / {goal_id} slot rendered as a safe raw string, indexed for search but not enum-validated
narrative / case_summary / plan body + optional milestones stepper (approach) or contact + urgency (need)
evidence refs + optional occurred_at distinct from claim time

strip internal case/ticket refs beyond self/family; sensitivity_tag / redaction_state for safe display; no scoring/consensus/routing — matching/response occurs via separate referencing claims (need broadcasts via edge_routing)
